title: Figures 4.7-4.9: IXL Double Well Potential, Ion Density, D-D Fusion Rate vs Current
description: Three plots from Tzonev et al.'s deep-well study. Figure 4.7 shows potential (keV) versus radius (m) calculated with the IXL code for dEperp=14 keV, Ii=55A, Ie=59A, with virtual cathode, virtual anode and real cathode marked. Figure 4.8 shows deuterium ion density (m^-3) versus radius with peaks at the center and near the grid; Figure 4.9 plots DD core fusion rate versus cathode current (A) with a power-law fit table (y = m1*m0^5).
